numerical_failure: Preserve same dataset and raw attempt; record affected model unavailable, continue other models.
timeout: Kill only owned stage process group; record model TIMEOUT; domain, audit and schema timeouts stop for engineering review.
resource_interrupt: Stop entire run after terminating owned stage group; retain partial attempt; explicit same-source resume starts a new attempt on identical data.
engineering_error: Stop on unexpected exception, invalid schema, unresolved support or hash mismatch.
